excerpt.zh:
我们在[from.solar_system.GetName]侦测到游牧的帝国出现。

我们欢迎他们进入我国境内，并对这次相遇可能带来的可能性和机遇充满期待。
excerpt.en:
We have detected the presence of a nomadic empire in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system.

We welcome them within our borders and remain eager for the possibilities and opportunities this encounter may bring.
